inputs.text: Sikhala is warning people not to accept the proposed constitutional amendments as routine legal housekeeping. They’re reportedly aimed at extending Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, and the push to dress that up as a constitutional process looks like a way for those in power to make their own extension seem legitimate. The missing details in the report don’t reassure me; they make it all the more important to reject the bill before this becomes a fait accompli.

subtopics: Concerns about legitimizing an extension of those in power
